# Rhetoric Minor (ENGL)
Source: https://academiccatalog.umd.edu/undergraduate/colleges-schools/arts-humanities/english-language-literature/rhetoric-minor/
Source: https://rhetoric.umd.edu/
Source: https://arhu.umd.edu/academics/undergraduate-studies/minors
Source: https://arhu.umd.edu/rhetoric
Fetched: 2026-09-28

## Catalog requirements

Fifteen semester hours of coursework are required:
Course | Title | Credits
Select six semester hours from the course list in Rhetorical Theory and Analysis of Discourse | 6
Select six semester hours from the course list in Writing and Speaking Skills | 6
Select three semester hours in electives from either section of the Rhetoric Course List | 3
Total Credits | 15
At least nine of the fifteen semester hours must at the 3xx-level or higher (including at least six hours at the University of Maryland, College Park)
No more than six of the fifteen semester hours may be taken at an institution other than the University of Maryland, College Park
No more than six of the fifteen semester hours may count toward the student's major and supporting courses
At least 3 semester hours must be taken in the English Department, and at least 3 semester hours must be taken from the Department of Communication
No course used to satisfy a Fundamental Studies requirement may count toward the minor
No course used to satisfy the requirements of another minor may count toward the rhetoric minor
No course grade below the grade of "C-" may count toward the minor
An overall GPA of 2.0 in the minor is required for graduation

Undergraduate Studies
Minors are an excellent way for students to gain expertise in an area beyond the major. We encourage students to work with their advisors early to incorporate the minor into their Academic Plans.
Applications for all minors remain open until the minor is filled. Students will be taken on a first-come, first-served basis. When you click on the “contact form” below and select the appropriate option on the form, your request will be marked with the date and time. Please keep in mind that any pre-requisites must be completed by the time of application. (Students applying to the Music Performance minor must successfully pass an audition and should contact the advisor through the form below as soon as possible.)
When a minor is listed as CLOSED, it is closed until October 1 in the fall semester or March 1 in the spring semester. You may check this site again at these times. When a minor is listed as WAITLIST, it is closed, but you may put yourself on a waitlist by clicking on "contact form" below and selecting the appropriate option.
